title: Casper and the Playlist
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Noor Montrose, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
